title: Spot the difference: farm
prompt: Three things changed between the two farm pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The brown rabbit changed colour from gray to brown, the pig changed colour from pink to plain and the blue umbrella changed colour from green to blue. Nothing else is different.
reviewNote: Independent review passed: answer re-derived from scene data, difficulty and safety checked. Published under the owner's 18 Nov 2026 direction.

options.text: The brown rabbit changed colour from gray to brown, a blue ball appeared and the blue umbrella changed colour from green to blue.
The brown rabbit changed colour from gray to brown, the pig changed colour from pink to plain and the blue umbrella changed colour from green to blue.
The brown bear changed colour from brown to purple, the pig changed colour from pink to plain and the blue umbrella changed colour from green to blue.
The brown rabbit changed colour from gray to brown, the pig changed colour from pink to plain and the brown bear vanished.
